title: Epic Explosives
description: This mod adds C4s and a lot of explosive mines like normal, fake, wither, poisonous & more!
body:
------------------------------------------------



Simple mod that adds C4s and explosive mines (normal, fake, wither, poisonous & more!)


Craftings in images

 
Warning: Setting the explosion radius above 15 may result in significant FPS loss or game crashes. Have fun! ;)



------------------------------------------------

Forge/NeoForge: (Active)

<details>
<summary>1.20.1: (Active)</summary>
  
v1.0:

-Total port of the mod for this version.

-1.2:

-Added Jumper Mine (makes you jump very high)

v1.3:

-Now all mines could insta-kill the player enjoy! (if you don't like that just use v1.2 instead)

v1.4:

-Added C4 (custom timer and then a very big boom, use at your own risk)
-Added translations (es_mx, es_arg, es_uy, es_es, pt_br and pt_pt)
-Added Defuse Kit (deactivates C4)
-Fixed Bug player defuse random C4 and disables the activated one.
-Changed Countdown messages now only the player who activated C4 will see them.
-Fixed you can only activate one C4. (now you can one by player.)
-Fixed potential crashes in Multiplayer

v1.5:

-Fixed Bug player could activate an activated C4 from another player.

v1.6:

-Total port of the latest update for this version and fixed bug mines can't kill.
</details>

v1.3:

-Can activate more than one C4
-Added commands: (Only for op)
  - "/EpicExplosivesC4 log" (laggy in big servers try to avoid it)
  - "/EpicExplosivesC4 log user <user> date <date>" (log by user and date)
  - "/EpicExplosivesC4 list" (list all active C4s)
  - "/EpicExplosivesC4 log date <date>". (log by date)
-Added C4s log (essential for multiplayer administration)
-Added config (change visual text position, radius of explosions, instant kill with mines, limit C4 by player)

v1.4:

-Fixed C4 timer input allowing invalid second values. The GUI now automatically converts overflow seconds into minutes (for example, 99 to 1:39).

v1.4.1:

-Fixed "desactivated" message when a player defuse
